<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Flowcatalyst\Events\Platform\Iam\User;

final readonly class UserCreatedData
{
    public function __construct(
        public int $count,
        public float $ratio,
        public ?int $optCount,
        public ?float $optRatio,
        public ?array $ints,
        public ?array $nums,
    ) {}

    /** @param array<string, mixed> $data */
    public static function fromArray(array $data): self
    {
        return new self(
            count: $data['count'],
            ratio: $data['ratio'],
            optCount: $data['optCount'],
            optRatio: $data['optRatio'],
            ints: $data['ints'],
            nums: $data['nums'],
        );
    }

    /** @return array<string, mixed> */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'count' => $this->count,
            'ratio' => $this->ratio,
            'optCount' => $this->optCount,
            'optRatio' => $this->optRatio,
            'ints' => $this->ints,
            'nums' => $this->nums,
        ];
    }
}
